description: Candidate version must not alter its frozen release criteria after implementation starts.
expected_behavior: Any attempted post-freeze criterion mutation requires a new future-version decision; current candidate remains judged against original criteria.
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_frozen_contract_mutation_detected

description: A candidate cannot promote itself based solely on its own evaluation.
expected_behavior: Promotion evidence includes an evaluator record separate from the implementation actor.
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_candidate_self_certification_detected

description: Previously fixed critical failure modes remain in the applicable regression set.
expected_behavior: Critical regression cannot disappear without explicit retirement/superseding decision.
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_critical_regression_cannot_disappear

description: Reference identifiers must not be misclassified as duplicate primary record identifiers.
expected_behavior: Multiple records may reference the same snapshot/decision/event ID without triggering DUPLICATE_ID; only primary record IDs are de-duplicated.
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_shared_reference_ids_are_not_false_duplicates

description: Historical release manifests must remain verifiable after legitimate successor changes without allowing historical release evidence to be silently rewritten.
expected_behavior: Append-only ledgers preserve and verify the release-time byte prefix; mutable shared source may change only when the exact prior release content is preserved in a version-local RELEASE-SNAPSHOT. Historical-prefix or release-snapshot mutation fails.
origin_incident: v0.04 pre-freeze recursive continuation defect EVT-SC-0033
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_append_only_manifest_prefix_survives_successor_append tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_append_only_manifest_detects_prefix_mutation tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_mutable_source_uses_release_snapshot tests/test_validator.py::test_historical_release_snapshot_mutation_detected

description: Adding records to an append-only historical JSONL ledger must not rewrite or reserialize any existing byte prefix.
expected_behavior: append_jsonl_records appends bytes only, preserves the complete existing prefix byte-for-byte, and rejects duplicate primary IDs before writing.
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_validator.py::test_append_jsonl_helper_preserves_existing_prefix tests/test_validator.py::test_append_jsonl_helper_rejects_duplicate_primary_id

description: Traceability impact output must use governed delivery-chain order rather than lexical identifier order.
expected_behavior: Upstream and downstream impact members are deterministic and ordered by Goal→Requirement→Feature→Task→Test→Gate type rank, then stable ID within a type.
origin_incident: v0.05 first implementation test failure EVT-SC-0051
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_traceability.py::test_impact_order_follows_traceability_chain_regression

description: A frozen successor evaluation corpus may embed artifacts that fail the promoted parent executable validator, making the frozen candidate impossible to evaluate without mutating preregistration.
expected_behavior: Pre-freeze corpus validation rejects any embedded traceability graph that fails the parent traceability schema; frozen invalid dependency fixtures are detected explicitly rather than ignored or rewritten.
verification_procedure: Run the ambiguity-corpus preflight regression; the historical v0.06 corpus must be diagnosed invalid and the v0.06.1 retry corpus must pass the same preflight.

description: The mutable top-level PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json was generated for v0.03 and not regenerated after later release files and append-only ledgers changed, so the shipped workspace failed its own package integrity validation.
expected_behavior: The shipping package manifest is generated after final release artifacts, covers the package contents except itself/transient caches, and validates with zero hash or size mismatches.
verification_procedure: Generate the package manifest in a fixture workspace, validate it, mutate a covered file to confirm failure, then regenerate at final package seal and require workspace validation PASS.

description: Preregistration helper appended requirement/task records with fields that did not satisfy the active JSON Schemas, leaving the workspace invalid after contract freeze.
expected_behavior: Schema-aware append validates every proposed record before writing any bytes; invalid requirement/task records leave the target ledger byte-identical.
verification_procedure: Run validated-append regression and confirm invalid proposed records raise before any bytes are appended.

description: Overlapping or stale preregistration writers can append records under stable IDs already present in a ledger, producing ambiguous history and invalidating machine reconciliation.
expected_behavior: Schema-aware append rejects any proposed stable ID already present in the target ledger and leaves the complete file byte-identical; release validation also rejects pre-existing duplicate IDs.
verification_procedure: Run the duplicate-existing-ID validated-append regression and workspace validator; both must prove duplicate IDs cannot be appended or silently tolerated.

description: Ambiguity marker matching can confuse ordinary domain language such as pending records with unresolved specification state, creating unnecessary owner questions.
expected_behavior: AMB-006 detects pending when it denotes unresolved status or a pending decision-like noun, but does not flag ordinary adjective uses such as zero pending records.
verification_procedure: Run the pending-status regression: the clean queue requirement emits no AMB-006, while Storage encryption mode is pending emits exactly one AMB-006.

description: A hash-locked evaluator can point at a transient preregistration hash instead of the hash embedded in the final immutable frozen contract, causing a false contract-drift failure.
expected_behavior: Evaluator corpus/plan hash constants equal the bytes of frozen artifacts and those exact hashes appear in the immutable release contract failure conditions.
verification_procedure: Recompute v0.06.1 corpus and plan SHA-256, compare them to evaluator constants, and verify both hashes are embedded in REL-0.06.1-FROZEN-001.

description: A version-local RELEASE-SNAPSHOT path may be occupied by explanatory metadata instead of the exact historical root file it is supposed to preserve, leaving successor changes unable to verify the prior manifest.
expected_behavior: Every release-snapshot fallback file referenced by a historical manifest is byte-for-byte the content whose SHA-256 the manifest declares; directory documentation must use a non-colliding path.
verification_procedure: Compare versions/v0.05/RELEASE-SNAPSHOT/README.md directly to the README.md hash/byte metadata in the v0.05 manifest/package snapshot, then validate the workspace after successor README changes.

description: Requirement/task/component blocks must stop when a following Markdown heading at level 1-3 begins, so explanatory higher-level sections cannot leak into normative ambiguity/lint scope.
expected_behavior: A ### requirement followed by a ## section containing ambiguity-marker examples yields no findings from the later section, while deeper #### content remains local to the block.
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_ambiguity.py::test_requirement_block_stops_at_higher_level_heading_regression

description: Descriptive taxonomy language containing the word unresolved must not be treated as an unresolved specification-state marker.
expected_behavior: Phrases such as unresolved alternatives/markers remain descriptive, while actual status forms such as "is unresolved" continue to emit AMB-006.
verification_procedure: pytest -q tests/test_ambiguity.py::test_unresolved_taxonomy_description_is_not_status_marker_regression tests/test_ambiguity.py::test_unresolved_status_still_detected_after_context_fix

description: A stale or truncated supplied discovery plan can omit a real decision-needed ambiguity and incorrectly make a project appear implementation-ready.
expected_behavior: Before compilation readiness, every decision-needed parent ambiguity candidate must be represented in the supplied discovery plan; missing candidates block compilation.
verification_procedure: Run the REG-0017 test and shadow case; an ambiguous source spec paired with an empty discovery action list must return blocked with TC-DISCOVERY-PLAN-INCOMPLETE.

description: Duplicate source_task_id metadata records can be silently collapsed by dictionary materialization, hiding conflicting source evidence.
expected_behavior: Compiler must reject duplicate source_task_id metadata before any dictionary construction or task compilation occurs.
verification_procedure: Run the REG-0018 test; duplicate task metadata must return invalid with TC-METADATA-DUPLICATE and may not compile using either record.

description: Generic field-name stable-ID validation can reject versioned namespaces that are valid only for a specific ledger, such as TEVT execution events and CTASK compiled task references.
expected_behavior: execution/task-events.jsonl accepts schema-valid TEVT-* event IDs and CTASK-* task IDs while historical EVT-* and TASK-* namespace checks remain unchanged elsewhere.
verification_procedure: Validate the v0.08 workspace with the execution ledger present and run the targeted validator regression; there must be zero INVALID_STABLE_ID errors for execution/task-events.jsonl.

description: A frozen evaluation benchmark must not label a negative fixture as defective when its governed semantic inputs are equivalent to an accepted control; preregistration must prove negative/accepted contrast before freeze.
expected_behavior: Every negative prompt-compiler fixture has a mechanically observable semantic mutation relevant to its expected diagnostic, and benchmark contrast preflight reports zero indistinguishable negative/accepted pairs.
verification_procedure: Run tests/test_prompt_compiler_retry_regressions.py::test_reg0020_negative_cases_have_semantic_contrast and inspect evaluation/v0091-benchmark-contrast-preflight.json.

description: Preregistration/freeze helpers must fail closed before creating a frozen contract when any mandatory prefreeze check is not green.
expected_behavior: No FROZEN-RELEASE-CONTRACT.json is written unless parent dependency preflight, schema preflight, benchmark semantic-contrast preflight, spec-quality checks, and inherited baseline all satisfy their declared preconditions.
verification_procedure: Run tests/test_prompt_compiler_retry_regressions.py::test_reg0021_freeze_preconditions_are_fail_closed and verify v0.09.2 preregistration evidence is all green before frozen_at_utc.

description: A release freeze transaction must validate the candidate frozen contract against the versioned contract schema before writing the recognized frozen-contract path.
expected_behavior: Contract construction runs JSON Schema validation and canonical-hash verification in memory; any schema error aborts before FROZEN-RELEASE-CONTRACT.json is written.
verification_procedure: Run tests/test_prompt_compiler_retry_regressions.py::test_reg0022_contract_schema_checked_before_write and inspect v0.09.2 prefreeze transaction evidence.

description: A retry-version evaluator can silently emit a stale predecessor metric name, preventing exact reconciliation to the frozen evaluation-plan namespace even when the underlying value is correct.
expected_behavior: Every non-null v0.09.2 evaluator metric name belongs to the frozen v0.09.2 primary/guardrail metric namespace, including v0092_spec_quality_acceptance_rate; historical v0.09 evaluator names remain unchanged.
verification_procedure: Run the REG-0023 evaluator test and verify evaluate_v0092_corpus emits v0092_spec_quality_acceptance_rate, never v009_spec_quality_acceptance_rate, while all emitted scored names are frozen-plan metric names.
